rl2.readingEasy: On the easy task, no measurable difference: same returns and same success rates on all 3 seeds, and the final Q − return gap stays between {min} and {max} for both variants.

rl2.readingSame: Same returns and same success rates on all 3 seeds; final Q − return gap between {min} and {max}.
rl2.reading: Curves come from this SHA's logs; they do not name an overall winner.

error.noSimulated: No simulated result: no curve and no table is shown while one of the two variants is incomplete.
error.qHeading: Q-values not logged in this run
error.qHint: The overestimation block stays empty: no substitute value is computed.

rl2.readingOverBoth: Both variants clearly overestimate during training: Q − return peaks between {pmin} and {pmax} depending on seed and variant (reading: peak above {thr}). By the end of the run, the Q − return gap is back between {min} and {max}. At equal seed the two variants differ by at most {between}, less than the spread between seeds of one variant (at least {seedSpread}): no winner on this bench.
rl2.readingOverFacts: Q − return peak per seed: DQN from {a0} to {a1}, Double DQN from {b0} to {b1} (reading: peak above {thr}). By the end of the run, the Q − return gap is between {min} and {max}. See the curves and the table, seed by seed.
